title: Mmepɔw so Nnwom a Wɔbɔ wɔ Anwummere
intro: Tie sɛ bonhwa de ayeyi gyegyeegye wɔ Allah akoa bi a wapaw no nkyɛn. Ɛnne a wɔde nnwom a ɛyɛ dɛ, atemmu a akyinnyegyefo hwehwɛ wɔ dan no mu, ne dade a ɔsoro ahyɛde ama ayɛ mmerɛw retwɛn sɛ wobehu. Ɔsom ne nniso a ɛteɛ ho mfonini bɛn na ɛnam saa nsɛnkyerɛnne yi so kasa?
clues: Allah de adom ne ayeyi nne a ɛyɛ dɛ hyiraa me.
Allah kyerɛkyerɛɛ me sɛ mɛte kasa a ɛfa atemmuo a ɛteɛ a ɛwɔ akasakasafoɔ ntam no ase.
Mehyiaa ɔkofoɔ kɛseɛ tumidifoɔ bi wɔ ɔko mu na ɛnam Allah pɛ so na midii wɔn so nkonim.
Wɔmaa me nyansa, tumi ne Nnwom kyerɛwsɛm a wɔada no adi a efi Allah hɔ.
Mmepɔw ne nnomaa bɛkaa me ho wɔ me nkyɛn de hyɛɛ Allah anuonyam anwummere ne owia apuei.
Allah kyerɛkyerɛɛ me sɛ memfa dade a wɔayɛ no mmerɛw ama me no nsiesie ntama.

outcome.answer: Wɔmaa no ahenni, nyansa, ne Zabur (Nnwom) .

arabic: إِنَّا سَخَّرْنَا ٱلْجِبَالَ مَعَهُۥ يُسَبِّحْنَ بِٱلْعَشِىِّ وَٱلْإِشْرَاقِ
verse: Indeed, We subjected the mountains [to praise] with him, exalting [Allāh] in the [late] afternoon and [after] sunrise. (38:18)
